# Pull Request

<!-- A pull request here proposes a change. A release replaces the content of `main`, so Spotware does not merge pull requests. When Spotware accepts the change, it ships the change in the next release, credits you in the changelog entry of that release, and closes this pull request with a link to that release. CONTRIBUTING.md describes the process. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] The change keeps the plugin read-only: it reads data and prepares links, and places, changes, closes or cancels no orders.
- [ ] The skill keeps a byte-identical `LICENSE.txt` (if applicable).
